values.binNote: XayahE#FeatherDamage = (BaseDamage + bADRatioxbonus ad) * (1 + (CritRatio=0.5)xcritChance*(1xcritDamage + -1)). The 1x coefficient on critDamage in this formula is not a separate named data value in the sheet (no row equals 1 for this purpose); it is an inline constant inside the calculation expression itself, so the coefScaling's '1' is only attested by that formula text, not a standalone DataValue row.

XayahE#MinionDamage = FeatherDamage * MinionMultiplier(0.5), so the base, AD ratio, and crit term are all half of FeatherDamage's; this matches the wiki's halved values. As with e_1, the '1' coefficient on critDamage is an inline formula constant, not a standalone DataValue row.

mechanics.claim: Bladecaller recalls all planted Feathers to shoot back to Xayah, each dealing damage on hit.
mechanics.quote: '''Xayah''' recalls all planted {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} to shoot back to her, each dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: Damage per feather is increased by critical strike chance scaled by critical damage bonus.
Bladecaller deals only half damage to minions.
Each successive feather that hits the same cast deals reduced damage per a diminishing-returns formula not stated in the tooltip.
mechanics.quote: The damage dealt by ''Bladecaller'' follows a diminishing returns formula not mentioned in the ability's description, successively reducing extra damage from feathers beyond the first.

mechanics.claim: An enemy hit by a given individual feather can only be hit by that same feather once per pass.
mechanics.quote: Enemies can be hit by an individual {{as|Feather|buzzword}} only once per pass.

mechanics.claim: Feathers still in flight are recalled too, but only after landing normally first.
mechanics.quote: {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} that are 'in flight' will be called to '''Xayah''' too, but only once they've landed normally first.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks only a single instance of the ability's damage (one feather), not all of them.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block a single instance of damage.

mechanics.claim: Bladecaller cannot be cast without a planted Feather on the ground, and cannot be ranked at level 1.
mechanics.quote: ''Bladecaller'' cannot be cast without a {{as|Feather|buzzword}} on the ground.
